rules: Every image or video generation that shows a subject below must attach that subject's 'attach' files as reference images.
Use the public raw URL (raw_base_url + path). Files only resolve once they are on the main branch; check with an HTTP request before generating.
If a subject's required references are missing, stop and tell the user which files to add instead of generating without them.
Prompts still repeat the subject's canonical descriptor word for word; references and descriptors work together.
Never redraw, re-letter or restyle the real packaging. The cartoon pouch character keeps the exact label layout of the product photos.
All reference images are supplied by the user. Never generate, edit or replace a reference image with any AI tool, and never change a reference file without the user's explicit approval.
When the user uploads a file listed under attach_when_available, check it on main and then move it to attach.

pouch.role: Real Mikoya JPN Matcha packaging (product shots, product held by people)
pouch.descriptor: A matte-black stand-up resealable matcha pouch with a zip top and small side tear notches, minimal white branding reading 'MIKOYA' between two short white lines, 'JPN MATCHA' in large white serif lettering, '100% Ceremonial' in small white sans-serif text, a thin-line green tea-leaf sprig illustration, '30g' near the bottom, and thin white corner-bracket lines.

pouch_character.role: Hero: the pouch brought to life (eyes, mouth, black stick limbs, white gloves, white sneakers)
pouch_character.descriptor: A matte-black stand-up resealable matcha pouch with a zip top and small side tear notches, minimal white branding reading 'MIKOYA' between two short white lines, 'JPN MATCHA' in large white serif lettering, '100% Ceremonial' in small white sans-serif text, a thin-line green tea-leaf sprig illustration, '30g' near the bottom, and thin white corner-bracket lines, brought to life as a cartoon character with two large round glossy cartoon eyes and a wide friendly mouth on the blank upper panel just below the zip seal, thin black stick arms ending in white four-finger cartoon gloves, and thin black stick legs ending in chunky white sneakers.

prep_set.descriptor: A matcha preparation set: a pale sky-blue horizontally ribbed ceramic matcha bowl with a pouring spout, a natural bamboo matcha whisk on a pale sky-blue ceramic whisk holder, a curved bamboo matcha scoop resting on a small pale sky-blue ceramic rest, and a stainless-steel fine-mesh sieve with a long looped handle.

bad_matcha.descriptor: A squat, lumpy cartoon mound of dull olive-brown oxidized matcha powder with a dry, clumpy, grainy surface, scattered rust-brown flecks, stubby grey-olive arms and legs, narrow yellowish eyes, heavy dark eyebrows, and a crooked yellowed toothy grin.

woman.descriptor: A young adult woman in her late twenties with light-medium skin, long straight chestnut-brown hair in a loose low ponytail, hazel eyes, a soft heart-shaped face with light freckles across the nose, and a slim average build, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater and light-blue jeans.

style.role: Global look for the animated hero-vs-villain format
style.descriptor: Polished vertical feature-film-style 3D cartoon animation with soft rounded proportions, big expressive eyes, simplified but tactile food and tea textures, warm cinematic lighting, sickly olive-brown and purple-grey accents for the villain, vivid jade-green and golden energy glows for the hero, shallow depth of field, 9:16 composition.

lifestyle.role: Photographic brand mood (real-photo and UGC formats only, not the cartoon format)
